import itertools
fixed = [(1,9), (2,9), (6,9), (3,10), (5,7), (2,8), (7,9), (4,6)]
fixed_set = set((min(u,v), max(u,v)) for u,v in fixed)
all_possible = list(itertools.combinations(range(11), 2))
print(len(all_possible))
remaining = [e for e in all_possible if e not in fixed_set]
print(len(remaining))
# Let's add first 30 from remaining to have total 38
selected = fixed + remaining[:30]
selected_sorted = sorted(selected)
print(selected_sorted)
print(len(selected_sorted))
